backup.current_check: metadata only; no new hash or payload read

recommended_input.policy: Fresh plain files imported inside the new live measurement group; no reuse of preexisting target inodes
required_order: Outside measurement group: restore verified archive to owned 20 GiB disk scratch image and mount read-only
Create fresh measurement group; import verified selected files into fresh plain host directory inside that group
fsync owned destination files and directories; close, unmount, detach and remove successful scratch source before sandbox writable volume allocation
Create original 8 GiB writable volume, private service and two guests; read-only bind imported commits; retain original dependencies and default reclaim
Record the prepared baseline, N=1/N=2 original 11 actions and five-second windows; preserve standard cleanup and failed evidence
recommended_input.integrity: Keep existing explicit backup and per-file content verification in preparation. All file reads are preparation cost and warm the cache; do not claim cold cache or keep pages resident.
recommended_input.ownership: New inode + first page creation by a process already born in the measured group; keep group alive through import and service. Old input inodes are not accepted by this new mode.
recommended_input.sync_scope: fsync individual owned plain files/dirs, never sync -f the shared host filesystem; sync -f remains only for the original owned writable filesystem

disk_budget.assumption: Fully reserved 20 GiB scratch + <=8 GiB plain cache during import; scratch removed before 8 GiB writable volume, so no 20+8+8 overlap. Existing archive is already on disk, not copied again.

scope.main: Raw cgroup current plus same-preparation increments
scope.input_cache: Fresh imported selected files; inode-deduplicated metadata inventory
scope.outside: Old source archive is preparation-only and is read outside the measured group; scratch file and inner filesystem removed before baseline. Shared executable/Docker/global costs remain separate unknowns.
scope.old_file_reuse: Not included in new-mode completeness claims. If later enabled, query per-file actual inside/outside/unknown ownership; mincore alone cannot allocate charge; never add all resident bytes to current.

first_validation.scope: One two-guest 22-action short sequence, no suffix or full task; no PSS or periodic mincore
required: New input inodes, recorded creator group and group-before-file-before-service ordering
No tmpfs seed, no scratch source mapping or mount before baseline; read-only commits source is the new plain directory
N=1 and N=2 common five-second windows; default reclaim and unchanged task outputs/exit codes
One selected-file mincore cross-check after both task windows, deduplicated by device+inode; record query cost and counters before/after. It supplements, not replaces, fresh-file provenance
Original automatic reports, writable-file boundary, read-only root, fixed 8 GiB writable allocation and all owned cleanup

next_stage: Offline implementation only, with fake metadata and mocked lifecycle tests; real preparation needs new authorization and >54 GiB free.
